decisions.summary: MysteryMarket is presented as operational audit/fieldwork execution, not as a full-service competing evaluation/reporting agency.
The Verify system is strategically reusable and should be preserved for reuse in other INSODEMA products/projects.
Public customer/partner relationships are only named in approved factual contexts; sensitive credential details may be code-gated.
Credential photos, logos and evidence documents live outside the public webroot and are served only through authenticated/verified asset delivery.
docs/ and source coordination material must not be synchronized into the public production web artifact. HTTP deny rules are defence in depth only.
Current Audits is removed from primary navigation and retained only as a supporting footer destination; it is not positioned as a public reference showcase.
The public Verify entry point is mysterymarket.de/verify without a .php suffix; legacy /verify.php remains internally compatible.
Public contact email addresses should not be present as directly readable mailto/plain addresses in initial HTML; they are reconstructed client-side as a pragmatic anti-scraping measure.
MysteryMarket V1 will release with the established light layout; the experimental dark concept theme will not be publicly selectable.
